mapper.select: select max(execute_time) from instance_slow_log where instance_id = #{instanceId}

select id,
from instance_slow_log where app_id = #{appId}

select id,
from instance_slow_log where instance_id = #{instanceId} and execute_time=#{executeDate} limit 10
select count(*) as count from instance_slow_log where app_id = #{appId} and execute_time between DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')

select app_id, count(*) as slowLogCount, DATE_FORMAT(execute_time,'%Y-%m-%d') gather_time from instance_slow_log where execute_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by app_id, DATE_FORMAT(execute_time,'%Y-%m-%d')

select upper(substring_index(command, ' ', 1)) as cmd, count(*) as calls, round(avg(cost_time) / 1000, 2) as avgCostMs, sum(cost_time) as totalCost from instance_slow_log where execute_time >= #{since} group by cmd order by calls desc limit #{limit}
mapper.delete: delete from instance_slow_log where app_id = #{appId} and execute_time < #{before}
mapper.select: select count(*) from instance_slow_log where app_id = #{appId} and execute_time < #{before}
